description: The same review with the changed collection opened, which is where @codeyam/cms 0.4.0 does its real work: the edit is described in words an editor recognises rather than as a +/- diff of markdown and YAML, and the diff itself moves behind a disclosure for whoever wants it. Both sides are parsed with the same lossless round-trip parser the editor saves through, so a reordered frontmatter key no longer reads as a change. Captured expanded rather than collapsed because collapsed proves only that a group exists — the summary is the thing worth seeing.
